title: The Foresight Brief: Chokepoints Past, Present and Future | World Economic Forum
text: The Foresight Brief examines the forces shaping the global future by interpreting drivers of change and allowing us to test our assumptions.The global economy depends on a network of critical connections. These chokepoints keep goods, resources and information moving. Yet their concentration of economic value and influence, combined with limited alternatives, makes them vulnerable, and disruption can trigger consequences across global systems.Written by the World Economic Forum in collaboration with the Atlantic Council, The Foresight Brief: Chokepoints Past, Present and Future explores how these strategic connectors have shaped the past, underpin the present and may evolve in the future. It examines chokepoints through four lenses – economics, geopolitics, governance and ecology – exploring the impact of digital infrastructure, climate change and emerging space-based dependencies.Drawing on historical examples and regional case studies, the report highlights how disruptions can cascade across interconnected systems. It calls on governments and businesses to practise strategic anticipation, identifying critical dependencies, diversifying alternatives and building resilience before crises occur.Follow this topic.
